title: Massachusetts off-site prescription-delivery counseling access
rule_summary: When a person elects delivery of a prescription drug at a location other than a pharmacy, M.G.L. c. 94C, § 21A permits the section's requirements to be satisfied by providing access to a toll-free telephone service that facilitates communication with the pharmacist at the pharmacy. The toll-free service number must be printed on a label affixed to each prescription-drug container dispensed by the pharmacy to the patient.
exam_relevance: Tests the Massachusetts off-site prescription-delivery counseling-access pathway and the required placement of the toll-free service number on each prescription-drug container.

authority.name: Massachusetts prospective drug review and counseling statute

common_confusions: Do not confuse the off-site delivery toll-free counseling-access pathway with the separate counseling-refusal documentation pathway.
The statute specifies the toll-free service number on a label affixed to each prescription-drug container; placement only on an outer shipping package is not the specified requirement.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts General Laws source independently checked on 2026-08-19; Section 21A expressly provides the off-site toll-free pharmacist-access pathway and requires the toll-free service number on a label affixed to each prescription-drug container.
